svg.aria-label: Four panels, one per temporal XOR case: no pulses, a pulse at sample 16 only, a pulse at sample 48 only, and both. Each shows the input and the 8 by 64 wire states.

g.text: a pulse at sample 16 if a is set, at sample 48 if b is set. The label is a XOR b.
the per-slot tanh bends each wire’s answer, so “both” is not the sum of “a” and “b”. A linear readout of raw samples
cannot tell both from neither: it scores 0.724.
the same readout on these 512 states scores 0.995 ± 0.009.
